location_qualifier: front southwest of Caen; Hill 112 sector as an approximation
source_locator: R601: Einsatz und Unterstellung (17 July 1944 entry); R594: footnote 2 to the II SS Panzer Corps list; R593: p. 326
current_activity: 10th SS Panzer Division being relieved southwest of Caen by the 271st Infantry Division; offered to LXXXIV Corps
notes: Event date: Lexikon der Wehrmacht, 271. Infanterie-Division page: "Ab dem 17. Juli 1944 lösten die vordersten Teile die 10. SS-Panzer-Division an der Normandiefront südwestlich von Caen ab"; Nafziger 944BGAA notes the 10th SS Panzer Division "being relieved by the 271st Infantry Division"; Schramm, OKW war diary (p. 326): on 17 July the OB West had put the 10th SS Panzer Division at the disposal of the LXXXIV Corps, but did not carry out the intention because the situation at Caen seemed too threatening. Location: the front southwest of Caen; the point is the dataset place Hill 112 (10th SS Panzer Division, 29 June), with a precision of 10 km. Location approximate: the sources name the front southwest of Caen, not a place; Hill 112 is the earlier position of the division. Location support: good: two source families (Lexikon and Schramm) agree that the division was still at the Caen front on 17 July. Relationship: the division stays in the II SS Panzer Corps relation CR0052.

current_activity: Model orders the 10th SS Panzer Division to continue past Arnhem into Germany for rehabilitation
notes: Event date: CMH Siegfried Line Campaign ch. 6 p. 127: Model "instructed the 10th SS Panzer Division to continue past Arnhem into Germany for rehabilitation presumably more thorough than could be accomplished near Arnhem"; "formally four days later on 9 September". Event definition: the order of 9 September; only minor elements of either SS division had begun to move when the landings came. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Arnhem with a precision of 25 km, on the route named in the order. Location approximate: a route point, not a documented position. Location support: CMH names Arnhem. Commander: unknown.

current_activity: Bittrich directs the whole 10th SS Panzer Division to Nijmegen to hold the Waal bridges
notes: Event date: CMH Siegfried Line Campaign ch. 7 p. 164: "The commander of the II SS Panzer Corps, General Bittrich, in turn directed the entire 10th SS Panzer Division to move to Nijmegen"; p. 142: "the 10th SS Panzer Division was to continue south to Nijmegen". Event definition: the order of the late afternoon or early evening of 17 September (p. 164: "Sometime during late afternoon or early evening of 17 September"). Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Nijmegen with a precision of 10 km. Location approximate: the destination of the order, not a documented position. Location support: CMH names the city. Commander: unknown. Opponents: US 82nd Airborne Division.
